panels.title: EQUITY CURVE — Is the bot actually making money?
Cumulative PnL (USD)
panels.description: This is your equity curve. Smooth upward line = healthy. Big drops = drawdowns. A good bot makes money slowly with occasional small dips. If this line is flat for weeks, the market is bad — not the bot.

panels.title: Max Drawdown
panels.description: Biggest peak-to-trough drop. <10% is excellent for a live bot. 15-20% is normal in strong trends. >25% means you should lower risk in config.

title: Sharpe Ratio
description: Risk-adjusted return. >1.0 is good. >1.5 is very good for crypto. This tells you if profits are coming from skill or just taking huge risks.

title: Win Rate
description: Percentage of trades that closed in profit. In Sentinel Edge 52-58% is normal and still very profitable because winners are larger than losers (see Profit Factor below).

title: Profit Factor
description: Total profit divided by total loss. >1.5 is good. 2.0+ is excellent. This is more important than win rate.

title: Expectancy per Trade
description: Average profit per trade after costs. Even $5–$15 per trade compounds fast at high frequency. Positive expectancy = the bot has a real edge.

title: Recent Trades with Reasons
description: Every closed trade. Click any row to see the exact Edge Score, Market Weather, and reasoning at the time. Use this to learn patterns. Example: trades with Edge>80 almost always win.
